state.objective: This language is written by coding agents. Rank correctness, safe refactoring, inspectable contracts and separately authored library composition above measured whole-task token cost. Count prompts, repair and validation as well as code; human comfort and short source are irrelevant. No external adopters require preserving prior forms. Lower to native JS/Bun wherever semantics agree, adding minimal immutable-contract support. These judgments guide experiments rather than grammar decisions or production changes.

state.values: DI-02 concerns invariants on authored immutable records. Current public type visibility also exposes construction, field observation and with replacement; frozen storage prevents mutation, not invalid initial contents. Private types cannot escape through exported signatures. Codec projection manufactures a nominal record from structural fields, bypassing user factories. Audited paths therefore permit invalid email(str value) via callers, replacement or decoding, although an end-to-end public-email probe was not run. A good current program can decode wire data, validate explicitly and check again at important boundaries; it cannot promise all instances of that nominal type are valid. Any experiment must jointly define comparison, representation visibility in patterns, updates, wire/schema operations and supplied fixtures. Exercise normalized emails, positive quantities and tenant IDs while checking authorization at each protected invoice operation. Package minting trusts owner implementations; universal validation introduces questions about recursion, effects, canonicalization and exact errors.
state.packages: DI-05a starts with qualified IDs and hashed output filenames already present, while the loading map Graph.Packages still requires globally unique terminal names. Duplicate model packages fail before file aliases are resolved; today's uses aliases only rename a successfully selected package. Direct-dependency visibility, canonical internal restrictions and the catalogue namespace must survive. The acceptance graph imports two unmodified same-named libraries into one source file and repeats after local alias edits, another transitive model and checkout relocation. Each library's imports use its own dependency bindings, and separate loaded instances or versions remain distinct. Source-map identities, locking and native module paths must agree. Requiring authors to declare full unique names is viable for newly authored libraries, but changes existing bare declarations and does not meet this unmodified-input benchmark.
state.errors: Error composition, DI-05b, separates fully specialized package/declaration identity from diagnostic integers. Current source declarations repeat active registry numbers in can.errors.json; dependency locks preserve them, and even retired entries reserve their integers throughout the entire graph. Graph loading, checking and runtime plan validation each reject duplicates. These known consumers have been inspected, but requirements for outside number-based reports or stable identities after release renames are not known. Any scoped, generated or textual reporting trial must update the registry, lock, plan and report contract consistently. Exercise independent equal active IDs and active-versus-foreign-retired IDs, trigger both errors and generic specializations, then interpret reports before and after adding a dependency. Declaration-level codes cannot collapse distinct instantiated error types. Bare hashing cannot promise collision-free integers. This topic relies on canonical package ownership without presuming an answer to the import question.
state.fixtures: For DI-06, the root identity is package/declaration/assertion name but fixture rows match just the active root label. Queue isolation already uses complete root and lexical-table identities plus invocation/reservation paths, with FIFO rather than argument search. An older executable caller-label edit from customer to renamed still checked yet caused text::from_int(7) in the helper to execute for real, replacing fixture text with 7; the helper unit case was unaffected. The defect is implicit selection, not queue sharing. Typed inert templates preserve local table ownership and inherit the use-site label, so they do not repair cross-package activation. Current whole-helper stubs and separately tested internals sacrifice combined-path coverage; explicit callable dependency injection is also available as a baseline. Preserve attached assertions, target and argument checking, per-table FIFO/path isolation for recursion and concurrent/callable participants, and honest real/supplied/raw evidence. Exercise renamed and duplicate roots, repeated helpers, recursion/concurrency and missing/unused links, disallowing silent real fallback for explicitly requested missing fixtures.
state.variants: The DI-07 checker combines a same-generic-declaration specialization veto with leaf inclusion for other assignments. Executed probes rejected direct tagged<int> -> tagged<str> but admitted a bridge variant and a shared unit leaf route; present type tests still support that matrix. It is path-sensitive static admission, not evidence of a memory bug or lost runtime identity. Runtime values and codec tags belong to nominal leaves, since variants currently have no wrapper constructor. Specialized generic records keep their own nominal distinctions. Required comparisons cover direct, bridge and unit cases, option<int>/option<str> with common none and distinct some<int>/some<str>, nested sets, new leaves, generic records and roundtrips. Pure sets intentionally do not brand; nominal record wrappers already offer a branding baseline. A new nominal variant regime would require conversion/matching and wire-representation changes plus allocation measurements. Agent edit costs have not been measured.
state.trial_policy: Choose trials for their ability to resolve the stated contract gap at bounded cost, not for adoption or taste. Compare a proposed mechanism to the strongest existing practice; demonstrated superiority is still absent. Register model settings, sample count and equal instructions/tools before creation, unseen refactor and repair tasks. Passing semantic tests and a repeatable current-idiom failure or material benefit beyond library/tooling changes are prerequisites to promotion. Use defer_measure when this record cannot support an informative next-prototype choice. Each of the five judgments uses the same evidence independently.

criteria.owner_record: Prototype separate visibility for a record type versus its constructors/replacements. Consumers observe only published frozen fields and nominal identity; hidden pattern fields remain inaccessible. Minting and default equality belong to owner APIs, with an explicit fixed equality export allowed. Deny generic decoding/schema, route wire data through factories and encode owner projections; fixtures acquire validated constants or factory values. Existing frozen nominal representation suffices, at the expense of owner trust and boundary plumbing.
criteria.opaque_value: Experiment with owner-only access to an opaque nominal payload. External code uses exported read/compare/transform functions and optional identity-only variant tests, never representation patterns or with. Forbid schema/codec derivation and let owner functions define wire conversion and errors. Assertion values come from the owner and are checked through published observations. Retain a frozen branded wrapper until safe erasure is established; weigh strict abstraction against API/adaptor and allocation costs.
criteria.checked_construction: Test a declared validation function that consumes representation and either normalizes it or emits named finite failures before any record exists. All construction, copying, document projection and fixture supply must invoke it. Public projections/matches and ordinary nominal field equality remain. Decoders expose structural plus predicate errors and schemas describe structure alone. Specify effects/recursive behavior; generate native calls and immutable-record adapters. Uniform checking trades for new failure sequencing at every creation site.
criteria.defer_measure: Delay choosing a boundary until cross-package email forging and current wire/factory/recheck code have executable results, including fixtures and decoding. Measure the disciplined baseline without claiming every record instance satisfies its predicate.

package_identity_trial.instructions: Select the next DI-05a technical comparison for duplicate short names with deterministic identities and direct-dependency restrictions; account explicitly for any candidate that first rewrites vendor declarations.

criteria.qualified_imports: Test explicit dependency-plus-package source selection with file aliases, current-project local lookup and unshadowable catalogue qualification. Resolve each dependency relative to its manifest and keep separate instances in locks/emission. Native imports follow canonical IDs; source-level clarity costs longer references.
criteria.manifest_handles: Test manifest-defined local import names whose values identify one direct dependency package, retaining per-file aliases. Nested projects resolve their own maps and reserve catalogue names; graph loading rejects incomplete or ambiguous handles. Canonical instances, not handles, drive locks/native imports. Compact source trades against manifest context and indirection.
criteria.qualified_declarations: Evaluate a regime requiring fully qualified package declarations from authors, while source aliases stay short. Rewrite the input libraries first and report failure to satisfy the original untouched-input requirement. Preserve version/instance identities and reject exact full-name collisions absent explicit resolution. The trade is naming coordination for fewer mappings.
criteria.defer_measure: Postpone a resolution prototype until an executable same-name graph and refactor/lock/checkout tests plus agent comparison inputs are available. Keep today's globally unique naming discipline only as the explicit failing composition baseline.

error_identity_trial.instructions: Which bounded DI-05b comparison should address overlapping diagnostic numbers while retaining exact nominal failures and honest report interpretation, given unknown outside numeric and cross-release requirements?

criteria.scoped_numbers: Test keeping source diagnostic integers but qualifying each by canonical owner throughout registries, locks, validation plans and reports. Retired values reserve only their owner's namespace. Preserve declaration/type-argument matching independently. Use ordinary maps and error metadata; this reduces allocation change but retains duplicate authoring and requires scope in every report.
criteria.build_numbers: Experiment with removing authored global numbers and assigning collision-free integers during the locked build. Archive the key-to-number map and require reports to identify that build; graph edits may renumber entries. Keep declaration tombstones and concrete type arguments separately from shared declaration codes. Update source, registries and all consumers, trading manual coordination for exact-map retrieval.
criteria.text_keys: Test self-identifying textual error keys with specialization parameters; numeric values become optional build-scoped conveniences with maps. Owner metadata governs retired identities and rename/reuse semantics. Revise authored numbering/registries and every consuming layer. Ordinary JS string metadata eliminates required map retrieval, but increases report size and makes identity evolution explicit.
criteria.defer_measure: First complete the consumer and identity-evolution audit and execute overlapping active/retired plus changed-build report examples. Do not yet prototype a replacement; retain current coordination only as the collision-prone control. Lack of external adopters does not determine the needed report semantics.

fixture_ownership_trial.instructions: Choose the next DI-06 technical trial for caller-label-independent scenario behavior, retaining exact lexical FIFO execution semantics and exposing the integration-coverage tradeoff against current test/injection practices.

criteria.lexical_only: Test a scope restriction on current rows so another package's root label cannot activate them. Reuse templates locally, stub a helper at the caller and test its body separately, or integrate real/injected dependencies. Retain current queue machinery with owner checks and no scenario references. This removes the fragile coupling but forgoes the caller's simulated internal helper path.
criteria.exported_scenarios: Prototype a callee-owned scenario export that configures its internal lexical tables and is referenced explicitly by the caller assertion at a checked call site. Scenario/declaration identities replace display-label equality; nested links are written and recursive/concurrent invocations stay isolated. Reject missing/private/conflicting/unused/signature-invalid references. Reuse plan/context routing while measuring exported-scenario maintenance.
criteria.exported_seams: Test exported typed call-site seams that a root supplies through explicit verified paths. Only the helper declares eligible signatures/targets; roots choose completions. Nesting, recursion and participants combine paths with runtime invocation identity for FIFO allocation. Reject vanished requested seams, unused mandatory supplies or incompatible signatures. Use current routing plans, avoiding a global override registry but increasing structural coupling.
criteria.defer_measure: Collect controlled rename and integration results for current local templates, caller stubs with helper unit checks, and injected callables before selecting new linkage. Do not equate their coverage or deny the demonstrated label failure; postpone the ownership experiment until the baseline costs are known.

criteria.extensional_leaves: Prototype uniformly set-based variant compatibility using concrete nominal leaves, without the exceptional direct generic-instance restriction. A phantom parameter with unchanged leaves has no branding force, so all equivalent paths work; specialized some records remain distinct while none fits both. Keep current flattened tags/codecs and test record identity plus agent refactoring against the baseline.
criteria.document_current: Compare a tooling/documentation improvement that retains same-generic-instance rejection before other leaf inclusion. Explicitly describe the resulting legal bridges/shared leaves and absence of transitive subtyping or branding. Runtime leaf matching and wire forms remain. Test whether clear static-type-dependent diagnostics suffice for agent edits.
criteria.nominal_wrappers: Prototype each variant instance as a nominal container holding an admitted leaf. Require explicit injections, narrowing unwraps and exhaustive conversions between containers; shared leaves permit only visible export-and-reinject, never implicit identity loss. Immutable tagged wrappers remain until erasure is proven. Wire decoding must recover the exact container from encoding or context. Compare conversion/allocation/repair costs with today's record-wrapper baseline.
criteria.defer_measure: Before choosing altered admission, expand baseline executions to options, specialized records, codecs and all bridge paths plus agent edits. State the present path dependence accurately and postpone a policy experiment pending the missing comparative data.
